g.text: Do stated probabilities match observed accuracy?
Five fixed probability bins. Bars show Wilson 95% intervals, not model uncertainty.
Hollow points: fewer than 20 examples. LLMs report verbalized probabilities; Jev supplies class probabilities.
Sparse bins and public-dataset contamination limit conclusions. Native Jev confidence is not used in this plot.
